subject.title: fix(ui): bound browser gateway WebSocket opening

question: Should browser WebSocket opening intentionally adopt the fixed shared 15-second default even though this phase has no user override?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents indefinite opening, but it deliberately converts very slow yet eventually valid browser upgrades into repeated failures; only maintainers can accept that compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept shared 15-second budget
options.body: Merge the bounded adapter behavior as consistent with the Node client’s default and accept retries for upgrades exceeding that budget.

options.title: Require an adjustable internal budget
options.body: Pause landing until the adapter or its caller can supply a different opening budget without adding a broad public configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Accept shared 15-second budget
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded adapter behavior as consistent with the Node client’s default and accept retries for upgrades exceeding that budget.
